name: Temperature-dependent I-V / transfer characterisation of a three-terminal semiconductor transistor in a closed-cycle cryogenic probe station (Lake Shore CRX series)
plain_name: Measure a semiconductor device on a cold probe station

sources.citation: Pucher, T., Mompeán, F., Rouco, V., León, C., Santamaría, J., Munuera, C., García-Hernández, M., Castellanos-Gomez, A. (2026). Mechanisms of Temperature-Dependent Hysteresis in Freestanding BaTiO3/MoS2 Heterostructures. Advanced Science, e77639.

Liu, F., Xue, J., Wu, G., Yuan, J., Yao, J., Liu, R., Guo, Z., Li, Z., Hu, H., Sun, W., Zhao, C., Zhang, C., Liu, X., Zhang, K., Zhang, J., Hao, Y. (2026). Gallium Nitride Semiconductor Resonant Tunneling Transistor. Advanced Science 13(13), e16334.

reported_conditions.as_printed: All electrical measurements were performed in vacuum
Lakeshore CRX-6.5 with HT stage; Lakeshore Model 336 (x2); Keithley 2450; Tenma 72–2715
measured on bare wafer (grown on 4-inch sapphire; measured piece size not stated)

requirements.rationale: Pucher et al. (2026) measured the transistor at 10, 70, 150, 200 and 296 K in a Lakeshore CRX-6.5 probe station; 10–296 K is that paper's cryogenic-to-room-temperature span (Liu et al. 2026 used 77 K and room temperature). This is the papers' choice, not a stated physical necessity; the user confirms the range.
Pucher et al. (2026) also measured at 420 K using the probe station's high-temperature stage; non-mandatory because the cryogenic characterisation does not depend on it.

Neither source states the number of probes. Both devices are stated to be three-terminal (Pucher: three-electrode source/drain/gate design; Liu: three-terminal RTTs), so contacting source, drain and gate implies at least 3 probe arms. This count is inferred, not observed.
Pucher et al. (2026) state all electrical measurements were performed in vacuum inside the probe station.

Pucher et al. (2026) report 1e-6 mbar (100 uPa) for the room-temperature output measurements; the vacuum level at low temperature is not stated, so this is non-mandatory and is this paper's condition.

missing_information: number of probes / probe arms not stated in either source (3 inferred from three-terminal devices)
chip / substrate lateral size not stated (Pucher gives only SiO2(290 nm)/Si; Liu measured on bare wafer, size of measured piece not stated, growth substrate 4-inch)
vacuum level at cryogenic temperature not stated; Liu et al. give no measurement vacuum
magnetic field not used / not mentioned
no RF / microwave measurement in either source
probe type (DC needle, tip material) not stated
Pucher et al. name a Lakeshore CRX-6.5 (not CRX-VF/CRX-4K/CPX/TTPX); Liu et al. name a CRX-4K but report only 77 K and room temperature
